rules.name: cs-26-fx-price-tie-20nov-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, cd.contract_number, cd.trade_id, cd.market_action, cd.transaction_date, cd.original_lots, dt.premium::text AS deal_ticket_price_text, cd.premium::text AS clone_price_text, round(dt.premium::numeric, 4) AS r4_decimal_half_away, (floor(dt.premium * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000)::numeric(18,4) AS r4_matlab_product, to_char(dt.premium, 'FM9999999990.0000') AS r4_printf_like, (round(dt.premium::numeric, 4) = cd.premium) AS clone_equals_rounded_deal_ticket FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table cd LEFT JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND is_latest_version = 1 AND premium IS NOT NULL GROUP BY trade_id) dt ON dt.trade_id = cd.trade_id WHERE cd.tenant_id = :tenant AND upper(cd.business_unit) = 'CFS' AND cd.is_latest_version = 1 AND upper(split_part(cd.contract_number, '_', 1)) = ANY (string_to_array(:fxClients, ',')) AND (dt.premium::text ~ '^(5\.8429|5\.843|6\.0096|6\.0097)' OR cd.premium::text ~ '^(5\.8429|5\.843|6\.0096|6\.0097)') ORDER BY cd.contract_number
